SUMMARY OF THE MONETARY POLICY COMMITTEE MEETING
The annual rate of increase was up in prices of core goods but slightly down in prices of services.

Inflation Developments

Monetary Policy and Risks
In light of these developments, the Committee concluded that aggregate demand conditions are in line with the outlook presented in the Inflation Report.
